items.title: Bias in Data Collection and Analysis (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Bias in Data Collection and Analysis' under topic 7.6 (PDF 101-102, printed 97-98).

blocks.text: Data jama karne mein bias tab hota hai jab data tamam groups ki barabar numaindagi na kare. Aisa mehdood data sources ya na-munsifana sampling (namoona lene ke tareeqe) ki wajah se ho sakta hai. Biased data ghalat aur gumraah-kun nataij deta hai. Analysis ke dauran researcher ke apne zaati andaze bhi bias la sakte hain. Aisa bias faislon par asar dalta aur na-insafi ko aur barhata hai. Qabil-e-bharosa nataij ke liye bias pehchanna aur kam karna zaroori hai, is liye ehtiyat se data jama karna aur ghair-janibdar (objective) analysis zaroori hai. Bias ki saadi misalein:

items: Survey bias: talaba ki karkardagi ka survey sirf top schools mein hua, aur average ya kamzor schools chhor diye gaye.
Sampling bias: sehat ki ek study mein sirf jawan log shamil hain, is liye nataij buzurgon ki numaindagi nahi karte.
Gender bias: naukri ke dataset mein zyada tar mard umeedwar hain, is liye model mard umeedwaron ko tarjeeh deta hai.
Geographical bias: sirf shehri ilaqon ka data dehi (rural) abadi ke faislon ke liye use hota hai.
Confirmation bias: researcher sirf woh data dekhta hai jo us ki raaye ko sahi sabit kare, aur mukhalif nataij nazar-andaz karta hai.
